newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SHEARER HAT-TRICK GIVES NEWCASTLE DRAMATIC WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SHEARER HAT-TRICK GIVES NEWCASTLE DRAMATIC WIN.

text.p: A 14-minute hat-trick from England captain Alan Shearer gave Newcastle United a dramatic 4-3 home win over Leicester City in the premier league on Sunday.

Newcastle took the lead in the third minute through Robbie Elliot and it stood that way at half time. But after the interval Leicester took a grip on the game to lead 3-1 on goals by Matt Elliott, Steve Claridge and Emile Heskey.
Shearer, however, lived up to his 15 million pound ($24 million) price tag and fired in a free-kick on 77 minutes.
Six minutes later he shot through a sea of legs to level the score and two minutes into injury time he snatched his hat-trick and three important points when he tucked away Lee Clarke's cross.
The win leaves Newcastle in fourth place, five points behind premiership leaders Manchester United.
